Maya (PM): Quick sync — Customer Atlas asked for eval-triggered alerts + per-route suggestion cards (batching / caching / quant). Thinking: 1) keep eval alerts opt-in, 2) suggest batching/quant profiles with cost/quality preview, 3) simple rollback and audit. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Luca (Eng-ML): Sounds good. Need to separate signals: concordance drop vs latency regression. They have different urgency and remediation.
Devin (Eng-Platform): Agreed. Also we should rely on telemetry to compute suggestion confidence. Example: if p50/p95 latency headroom > X, suggest larger batch.
Maya (PM): Priority is pilot-friendly: non-invasive suggestions + a dry-run mode. Pilot scope: Atlas + one other mid-market customer.
Priya (SRE): Ops guardrails: suggestions must never auto-change runtime config. Only UI suggestions and a dry-run API that returns simulated cost / latency. Add a kill switch and audit logs.
Sam (CS): Atlas is okay with opt-in. They specifically want predictable rollback and an estimated cost delta before enabling.
Luca (Eng-ML): Prototype scoring idea (very rough):
```
score = 0.6*latency_savings + 0.3*cost_savings - 0.1*quality_risk
if score > 0.7 -> show suggestion with confidence tier
```
We should define quality_risk as eval delta on a holdout prompt set (concordance / F1).
Devin (Eng-Platform): For quantization suggestions: only propose int8/fp16 when eval delta < 0.02 (concordance) and model supports the kernel. Also include a compatibility flag per model-version.
Ana (Design): UI needs: a compact suggestion card with: suggestion title, projected tokens/sec, est $/1000 tokens, expected quality delta, confidence badge, and a preview button. I can mock this up.
Maya (PM): Draft launch criteria: (a) 2 pilot customers onboarded, (b) false-positive suggestion rate < 5% on pilot dataset, (c) dry-run API + audit logs + rollback API, (d) docs + quickstart, (e) design mockups + product acceptance tests.
Priya (SRE): Add: feature-flag per org with global kill-switch, rate limiting for suggestion evaluation jobs, and retention of suggestion decision logs for 90 days.
Sam (CS): I'll confirm Atlas + one customer from fintech by EOD Wed. I can also collect sample prompt sets for evaluation.
Luca (Eng-ML): Also note: long-tail prompts can bias scoring. We need an eval harness that samples traffic distribution and labels concordance.
Maya (PM): Action items (owners + due):
- Luca: eval rules + harness + quality_risk metric (due Fri)
- Devin: backend scoring service + dry-run API + compat table (due Fri)
- Ana: mockups for suggestion card + microcopy (due Mon)
- Priya: kill-switch, rate limits, audit log schema (due Mon)
- Sam: pilot commitments + sample prompt sets (EOD Wed)
Everyone: ack?
Sam (CS): :thumbsup:
Luca (Eng-ML): ack
Devin (Eng-Platform): ack
Priya (SRE): ack
Ana (Design): ack
deploy-bot: Deployment started: optimize-suggestions/v0.1 -> staging (build #241)
Maya (PM): Thanks — I'll add this to the roadmap doc and surface a short RFC. Will ping when RFC is ready for review.
